meta.title: CAROS Affiliate Program
meta.description: Partner with CAROS to help service businesses build stronger revenue systems.

hero.title: Partner With CAROS.
hero.body: Know business owners who could benefit from a stronger revenue operation? Apply to become a CAROS Affiliate and earn by introducing qualified businesses to a system designed to help them capture opportunities, convert more leads, understand their marketing performance, and grow revenue.
hero.micro: Applications are reviewed by the CAROS team within 1–2 business days.

process.title: Build Relationships. Make Introductions. Let CAROS Take It From There.
process.body: CAROS affiliates introduce qualified business owners who may benefit from CAROS. Once the introduction is made, the CAROS team handles the consultation, qualification, onboarding, and ongoing client relationship. The affiliate's role is to create the connection, not become a CAROS salesperson or provide CAROS services.

apply.title: Apply
apply.body: Tell us about yourself, your network, and how you plan to introduce CAROS.

approved.title: Get Approved
approved.body: Our team reviews your application and determines whether the partnership is a good fit.

refer.title: Start Referring
refer.body: Approved affiliates receive their referral resources and tracking information so qualified introductions can be properly attributed.

fit.title: Is the CAROS Affiliate Program a Fit for You?
fit.body: The program may be a strong fit if you have trusted relationships with business owners and regularly make professional introductions or recommendations.

items.creators: Content creators with relevant business audiences
items.homeServices: Professionals with strong relationships in the home-services industry

fit.final: You don't need a massive audience. A trusted relationship with the right business owner can be more valuable than thousands of followers.

form.title: Tell us about yourself.
form.websiteHelp: Enter your business website, LinkedIn profile, or the social platform where you're most active. This helps us understand your professional presence.
form.promo: How do you plan to promote or refer CAROS?
form.audience: Tell us about your audience or professional network.
form.audiencePlaceholder: Who do you typically serve or influence? For example: small business owners, marketing agencies, service entrepreneurs, SaaS founders, home-service business owners, etc.
form.motivation: Why do you want to become a CAROS affiliate?
form.motivationPlaceholder: Tell us what draws you to the CAROS Affiliate Program and why you think you'd be a strong referral partner.
form.estimate: How many referrals do you estimate you could generate in the next 90 days?
form.source: How did you hear about the CAROS Affiliate Program?
form.consent: I agree that CAROS may contact me regarding my affiliate application and the CAROS Affiliate Program. I understand that submitting this application does not guarantee approval or enrollment.
form.error: We couldn't submit your application just yet. Your information is still here. Please try again in a moment.

success.title: Application Received. Thank You.
success.body: We've received your affiliate application. Our team will review it within 1–2 business days. If we think you're a strong fit, someone from CAROS will contact you using the information you provided.
success.second: In the meantime, learn more about how CAROS helps independent businesses understand and improve the journey from marketing investment to revenue.
